scope: Exactly 12 new diagnostic replays (six per arm) and six unique parent-4db controls loaded from the already-preserved 77-game extraction by exact SHA. No control replay was re-extracted.
method: Existing tools/replay/extract.mjs was run on only the 12 new replay outputs with one thread. Resulting events and per-round columns were analyzed offline. Candidate-team camp champion deaths use the event field death.camp; bag loss sums death.gems. Banked gems are tribute_end.gems.
interpretation_limit: This is selected-mechanism evidence, not a strength comparison. Identical normalized events and per-round state for first/basic on a cell show no observable effect unique to the emergency-camp-basic addition in these cells, but do not prove internal branch call behavior. Camp HP at champion death is unavailable. A candidate outcome change vs its reused parent-4db cell does not identify a single cause.
supersedes_note: survival-activation-diagnostics-v2.json undercounted camp deaths by checking a nonexistent by="camp" marker. It is preserved as an attempt artifact; this v3 uses the documented death.camp field and is the corrected summary.
